exposure: Process of services (participants, delivery mode, referral pathways)
Types of supportive cancer care interventions
outcome: Prevalence of conventional supportive cancer care interventions
Specific services offered (e.g., psychological therapy, exercise, fatigue management, pelvic health)
cohort: The study surveyed 265 cancer organizations across all Australian states and territories that provided cancer-directed treatment, clinical cancer care, or conventional supportive care interventions.
finding: The study found that while many conventional supportive cancer care services are provided in Australia, specific areas like fatigue management, pelvic health, and others are less common, and online resources and telemedicine are currently underutilized modalities.
